name: prestashopheaven/build-package-index
description: The index of the PrestaHaven package collection: every package of libraries/mono-*/packages with its public classes and methods, a ranked search (ps-module find) and the one-line catalog for CONTEXT.md.

prestashopheaven.use-when: Before writing code for a module or package: search whether one of our packages already does it (ps-module find "<need>"), or generate the package index and the one-line catalog for CONTEXT.md.
